name: AGH University of Krakow
summary: Kraków technical university of about 21,000 students; seven English bachelor's in computing, physics, geology, mechanics and space.

ib.text: Ranked on IB grades: maths (SL, or HL) x2 plus your best two listed HL subjects x6 and x2, each rescaled to 30-100, out of 1000; 300 needed. With an IB you skip AGH's maths exam.

lastYear.text: 1 June–9 July (10 am CEST); later cycles if places remain

programmes.name: Computer Physics
programmes.about: Physics and mathematics combined with computational methods: modelling, simulation and data analysis of physical and engineering problems, at the Faculty of Physics and Applied Computer Science.

needs.note: Counts twice (M): your SL grade, or HL if you took maths only at HL
Best HL grade from this list counts six times (P1)
Another HL subject from this list counts twice (P2)

programmes.selectionNote: Ranked on AGH's 1000-point index: 2 x maths + 6 x best listed HL + 2 x second listed HL, grades rescaled to 30-100; 300 needed. 2027 rules.

notes: Without Polish citizenship you apply through AGH's international recruitment and pay the programme fee; EU citizens get no lower rate.
With an IB diploma you need no apostille or NAWA statement, and as an EU citizen at a school in the EU or OECD no English certificate.
You apply after your IB exams and type your IB grades into e-Rekrutacja yourself; the diploma scan goes in with them.
